--- change 3 (repo omnimarket, pull request #3875) ---
fix(OMN-21078): a customer's chosen OpenRouter model, a :free one too, is called once and never re-aimed (#3875)
* fix(OMN-21078): stop re-aiming customer-chosen free models

Before: on a provider whose catalogue row says the customer chooses the model (OpenRouter), the delegation call effects let a model through unswapped only when it matched none of the catalogue's preference patterns. Every OpenRouter preference is a :free slug, so a customer-chosen google/gemma-4-31b-it:free fell through to the re-aim: a 404 moved the call to another model and stored that model over the choice, and a 429 was answered b

fix(OMN-13857): onex run-node fails fast with an actionable message (#1374)
onex run-node dispatches over Kafka. Before this fix an unset
KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS raised a bare KeyError traceback, and an unreachable
broker surfaced an opaque confluent_kafka.KafkaException (_TRANSPORT) — neither
told the operator what to do. Both now emit a single actionable SkillRoutingError:

- _resolve_bootstrap_servers(): unset/blank KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS emits a clear
  error naming the env var and the bus-less 'onex run <node>' fallback, instead
  of KeyError.
- publish_and_poll()
